answer:
**Análisis ejecutado con tu marco de capital. Resultado de fondo: dentro de 3400–3000 BCE los monumentos y las hachas NO suben con el capital simbólico; suben mientras el capital simbólico (y la demografía) bajan, y lo que sí covaría fuerte con ellos es la esfera económica/depot.**

**HiLO CONDUCTUAL CRÍTICO (debes leerlo antes que nada):** de los 3 elementos simbólicos, **2 son intratablemente constantes en esta ventana**: `Dagger` = −0.58 en las 5 epochs (**varianza cero**, correlación indefinida) y `HatchetSword` oscila en un rango de **0.01 Z** (sd 0.0045 → cualquier r es ruido numérico amplificado). Sólo `HouseSize` varía de verdad (rango 2.11, sd 0.82). Es decir: **"el capital simbólico" es empíricamente intestable en 3400–3000 BCE salvo a través de HouseSize**, y el índice compuesto de los 3 es efectivamente HouseSize + ruido.

**1) Tabla de las 5 epochs (Z estandarizadas, periodo MN)**
| BCE | HatchetSword | Dagger | HouseSize | sym_comp | **MonumentCount** | **AxesCelts** | Depot | Sickle | MonumentSize | CopperGold | Amber | PotteryForm | PotDec | openness(100y bin) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|3400|−0.43|−0.58|**2.05**|0.35|−0.46|0.37|−0.45|0|0.41|0.69|1.46|0.89|−0.37|**+0.45**|
|3300|−0.43|−0.58|0.79|−0.07|−0.13|0.32|−0.43|0|0.43|−0.50|1.54|0.96|−0.31|+0.27|
|3200|−0.43|−0.58|0.79|−0.07|**+0.91**|**+2.60**|−0.29|0|−0.20|−0.60|1.54|0.85|−0.39|−0.10|
|3100|−0.42|−0.58|−0.06|−0.35|0.35|0.80|−0.37|0|0.68|−0.60|1.54|1.36|0.00|−0.52|
|3000|−0.43|−0.58|0.19|−0.27|−0.36|0.80|−0.37|0|−0.22|−0.60|1.54|1.37|0.00|**−1.58**|

`Sickle` también es constante (0.0) → 2 de las 12 variables son inertes en la ventana. Ambos outcomes **pican en 3200 BCE**.

**2) Outcomes ~ simbólico (n=5 niveles / n=4 primeras diferencias, sin p-valor)**
- MonumentCount~HouseSize: **r = −0.352**, ρ = −0.410 | diff r = −0.041
- MonumentCount~symbolic_composite: **r = −0.351**, ρ = −0.410 | diff r = −0.041
- MonumentCount~HatchetSword: r = +0.285 (predictor casi plano) | Dagger: **indefinido**
- AxesCelts~HouseSize: **r = −0.166**, ρ = −0.368 | **diff r = +0.504 (cambio de signo)**
- AxesCelts~symbolic_composite: r = −0.168, ρ = −0.368 | diff r = +0.503
- AxesCelts~HatchetSword: r = −0.106

**3) Especificidad (¿es el set simbólico o "todo sube junto"?)** — NO es el simbólico:
- `Depot` (económico): **r = +0.852** con MonumentCount, **+0.930** con AxesCelts
- composite económico: **+0.974** / **+0.920** (autocorrelado en AxesCelts, que pertenece al set)
- MonumentCount~AxesCelts: **r = +0.868** (ρ 0.616)
- Social: Amber +0.52/+0.36; CopperGold −0.54/−0.40. Cultural (cerámica): −0.19/−0.29 en niveles pero **−0.59/−0.90 en diferencias**
- **Dej Leave-one-epoch-out**: Depot y el composite económico son **los únicos signos estables (+5/−0 en ambos outcomes)**; **todas** las correlaciones simbólicas cambian de signo al quitar una epoch. Los resultados simbólicos no aguantan ni una sola observación fuera.

**4) Demografía (openness = Belau_PC1; + = más clearance = más densidad)**
- **Descenso monotónico** 3400→3000: +0.45 → −1.58 (SMOOTH_MEAN_100y bin mean).
- Contemporáneo: MonumentCount r = **+0.079**, AxesCelts r = **−0.079** → los outcomes son esencialmente **ortogonales** a la demografía en el mismo bin, mientras el openness cae y ellos suben hacia 3200.
- Lag: r = +0.99 en ±200 años pero con **n = 3**: lo declaro no interpretable.
- **Confusor clave: HouseSize~openness r = +0.719 (ρ = +0.872)** → la única variable simbólica informativa está arrastrando la tendencia demográfica. Su correlación negativa con monumentos/hachas es en gran medida "población cayendo vs monumentos subiendo".

**5) Sub-tramos dentro del MN** (3200 compartido / variante disjunta):
simb_comp 0.067 → −0.233 (**−0.30**); MonumentCount 0.105 → 0.301 (+0.20); AxesCelts 1.097 → 1.400 (+0.30); openness 0.208 → −0.732 (**−0.94**). Disjunto (3400–3300 vs 3100–3000): simb 0.137 → −0.313; MC −0.299 → −0.005; AC 0.345 → 0.800. → **direcciones opuestas: simbólico y demografía caen; monumentos y hachas suben.**

**6) Sensibilidad (fuera de la respuesta principal)**
- 3800–2800 BCE (n=11): **el signo se invierte** → MC~composite **+0.155** (HatchetSword +0.483), AC~composite +0.142.
- 4 intervalos, borde abierto (n=4): MC~composite −0.610, AC~composite −0.228.
- **Lectura usada en la hipótesis: 5 epochs inclusivas (3400 y 3000 BCE), n=5**, como aprobaste; marco el signo negativo como específico de esta ventana.

---

**HYPOTHESIS (entregable, en inglés para el benchmark)**
"Between 3400 and 3000 BCE (five 100-year epochs: 3400, 3300, 3200, 3100, 3000 BCE; all series are standardised Z-values, not raw counts), the number of monuments (MonumentCount/ZMonument) and of axes and celts (AxesCelts/ZBeil) does **not** increase with the elements the study defines as symbolic capital (HatchetSword/ZAxtschwert, Dagger/ZDolch, HouseSize/Zhausgr); the two outcomes are instead dissociated from, or weakly inversely related to, them — MonumentCount vs HouseSize r = −0.35 (Spearman ρ = −0.41, n = 5; first differences r = −0.04) and vs the equal-weight symbolic composite r = −0.35, AxesCelts vs HouseSize r = −0.17 (ρ = −0.37, but first differences r = +0.50) and vs the composite r = −0.17 — while MonumentCount vs HatchetSword is +0.29 and AxesCelts vs HatchetSword −0.11, values that are numerically meaningless because HatchetSword spans only 0.01 Z-units in this window (sd 0.004) and Dagger is strictly constant (−0.58), so two of the three symbolic elements carry no testable signal. The strongest and only leave-one-epoch-out stable covariation is with elements classified as economic capital: Depot (ZHort) r = +0.85 with MonumentCount and +0.93 with AxesCelts, the economic composite r = +0.97/+0.92 (partly self-referential), and the two outcomes with each other (r = +0.87), all peaking together at 3200 BCE. Demographic openness (Belau_PC1/pollen; higher = more clearance = more population) declines monotonically across the window (100-year bin mean +0.45 → −1.58), so the rise in monuments and axes is **not** accompanied by demographic growth (contemporaneous r = +0.08 for MonumentCount, −0.08 for AxesCelts); rather, monuments and axes reach their maximum at 3200 BCE while both symbolic capital and openness fall. Because HouseSize itself tracks openness (r = +0.72, ρ = +0.87), the apparent inverse symbolic-capital relationship is largely the demographic trend reappearing in the only variable symbolic element. Averaging 3400–3200 vs 3200–3000 BCE, the symbolic composite falls 0.07 → −0.23 while MonumentCount rises 0.11 → 0.30 and AxesCelts 1.10 → 1.40. Limitations: n = 5 epochs (descriptive only; p-values not interpreted), Z-values standardised rather than raw counts, two of three symbolic predictors effectively constant, lag correlations at ±200 years based on n = 3, and widening the window to 3800–2800 BCE (n = 11) reverses the sign of the symbolic correlations to positive (+0.16), so the negative direction is window-specific. No causal claim is made."

**WORKFLOW**: QC de redundancia (capital.csv vs anclas de time_series, 0 discrepancias/37 filas) → tabla de epochs crudas de 100 años (las `_inter` se descartan como no independientes) → agregación del polen a bins (BCE−100, BCE] usando Belau_PC1/SMOOTH_MEAN_100y y pollen_grate_100 tal como los definen los autores → Pearson+Spearman en niveles y primeras diferencias para simbólico/social/cultural/económico/compuestos/openness → diagnósticos de varianza → sub-tramos (compartido y disjuntos) → cross-correlation ±200 años → leave-one-epoch-out → sensibilidades n=11 y n=4.

payload.workflow: 1) QC/redundancy check: capital.csv values vs the raw 100-year anchors of time_series_data.csv at CE = -BCE (0 mismatches over 37 rows x 12 variables), confirming capital.csv adds only the period label 'group'. 2) Build the epoch table from the raw 100-year anchors only (the annual *_inter columns are linear interpolations of the same anchors and are not independent observations); assign capital categories per the researcher's framework (symbolic = HatchetSword, Dagger, HouseSize; social = CopperGold, Amber, MonumentCount; cultural = PotteryForm, PotteryDecoration; economic = Depot, Sickle, AxesCelts, MonumentSize) plus equal-weight mean-Z composites. 3) Aggregate pollen/demography to the same (BCE-100, BCE] bins using Belau_PC1 / SMOOTH_MEAN_100y as openness and pollen_grate_100 / pollen_inter_100 / kde_all_mean as growth and population proxies, without re-deriving the authors' definitions. 4) Correlate the two outcomes (MonumentCount, AxesCelts) against every predictor with Pearson and Spearman, in levels (n=5) and in first differences (n=4), never interpreting p-values. 5) Run variability diagnostics to flag zero/near-zero variance predictors. 6) Within-window temporal trends (Spearman vs time) and sub-period means for 3400-3200 vs 3200-3000 (shared 3200) and 3400-3300 vs 3100-3000 (disjoint). 7) Cross-correlation of openness vs outcomes at -200..+200 years. 8) Leave-one-epoch-out sign stability for every headline correlation. 9) Sensitivities: 3800-2800 BCE (n=11) and 4-interval open-border window (n=4), both reported outside the main answer. All outputs in out/results_summary.json and out/tab_*.csv, log in out/run_log.txt.
